decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a standard core format for a POS display maker and costs little to keep in a made-to-order portfolio.
The pegboard-back shelf display serves ongoing demand for hanging small items in retail promotions and fits the firm's established cardboard production.
The quarter-pallet shelf display is one of the most common promotional display formats in German retail and is central to the firm's offer.
The eighth-pallet display is a standard small-format option that brands use in space-constrained stores, so it stays useful in the portfolio.
The wooden display pallet sits outside the cardboard core and carries more risk, but it complements display shipments and the firm has no clear reason to drop it.
Physical media sales are shrinking, which raises the risk for this display, but the design is easily adapted from the quarter-pallet base and costs little to keep offering.
